discovery: Discovery of galaxies in the early universe and the charting of cosmic star-formation history back to the first billion years
motivation: These three scientists turned the early universe from speculation into an observed record. Steidel developed the Lyman-break technique, which reliably found and confirmed spectroscopically large populations of normal galaxies at redshifts above 3. This established how galaxies and the intergalactic medium evolved together. Illingworth led the deepest Hubble imaging campaigns (HUDF09, XDF) and the systematic searches that pushed galaxy detection to z~10, measuring how the luminosity function built up during reionization. Ellis pioneered gravitational-lensing and deep spectroscopic surveys, including UDF12, that established the earliest galaxy populations and their role in reionizing the cosmos. Together their work set out the cosmic history of star formation and the strategies that let JWST confirm galaxies within 300 million years of the Big Bang. It changed our picture of cosmic history and grounded galaxy formation in physics.
